meta_description:
65K likes, 572 comments - figuringout.co on October 6, 2026: "Comment ‘BRAIN’ and we’ll personally DM you the full conversation.

What is one memory from your childhood that you still remember vividly?

In today’s episode, we sit down with Nikolay Kukushkin (@niko_kukushkin) Neuroscientist & 
Author, One Hand Clapping a memory scientist who calls himself a “molecular philosopher” and studies how molecules and cells create memory, motivation and consciousness.

Here’s what we discussed:
-Why Your Brain Rewrites Memories: How recalling a memory can actually change the way you remember it.
-Can Talking About Trauma Make It Stronger?: Why repeatedly revisiting certain memories may affect how strongly they stay with you.
-The Man Who Remembered Everything: What extreme memory can teach us about the way our brains process and store experiences.
-Why Dopamine Is About Wanting: Why dopamine is more connected to motivation and pursuit than simply feeling pleasure.
-Why You’re Never Fully Satisfied: How evolution shaped our brains to keep wanting more, even after achieving what we wanted.

Catch the full episode here:
YouTube Channel: Raj Shamani
Spotify Channel: Raj Shamani Figuring Out

Until then, keep figuring out! 🚀

#rajshamani #figuringout".
